user.title: Hauswacht
user.description: Set up the Hauswacht intrusion alarm. The alarm starts disarmed. Sirens are not controlled in this version.

code.title: PIN code
code.description: Current status: {pin_status}. The PIN is stored hashed only. Without a PIN, the alarm must not be exposed to voice assistants.

profile_settings.title: Profile {profile}
profile_settings.description: Choose which zones this profile monitors and how it behaves.

zone_add.title: Add zone
zone_add.description: A zone contains the selected sensors plus all binary sensors carrying the chosen label (label set directly on the entity).

zone_edit_settings.title: Zone {zone}
zone_edit_settings.description: A zone contains the selected sensors plus all binary sensors carrying the chosen label (label set directly on the entity).

zone_delete.title: Delete zone
zone_delete.description: The zone is also removed from all profiles.

roles.title: Sensor roles
roles.description: The role is derived from the device class (door: entry delay, window: instant, motion/presence: follower, tamper: 24h). Set exceptions here. Current exceptions: {overrides}

monitoring.title: Sensor monitoring
monitoring.description: A sensor that has not reported for this long counts as unavailable when arming. 0 = off. Battery sensors may report only every few hours, so choose generously.

infrastructure.title: System monitoring
infrastructure.description: Binary sensors that report "on" while a system is running, e.g. the Zigbee2MQTT bridge connection state. If one of them is off or unavailable, Hauswacht reports a fault and treats arming as with unavailable sensors.

sirens.title: Sirens
sirens.description: Register the sirens Hauswacht may use for intrusion alarms. Fire safety: Hauswacht never switches a siren on or off while any smoke detector reports fire, or while the fire state of a registered siren is unknown. Siren control stays LOCKED until you enable it here and confirm.

data.confirm_hardware: I confirm: real sirens may sound during an alarm

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: System messages (fault, sensor lost, tampering, restart) go to these services. Alarm messages are configured per profile.

data.notify_in_test_mode: Send notifications in test mode too

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must consist of 4 to 8 digits.
error.zone_empty: Select at least one sensor or a label.
error.confirm_hardware_required: Please confirm that real sirens may sound.

abort.disarm_first: Please disarm Hauswacht before changing options.
abort.no_zones: No zones have been created yet.

rejected_not_disarmed.message: Hauswacht must be disarmed before arming another profile.

confirmation_required.message: Arming needs confirmation. Open: {open}. Unavailable: {unavailable}. Use the action hauswacht.arm with confirm to arm anyway.

rejected_test_mode_change_requires_disar.message: Test mode can only be changed while disarmed.

profile_has_no_sensors.message: Profile {profile} does not monitor any sensors. Assign zones in the Hauswacht options first.

simulation_requires_test_mode.message: Simulation is only possible while test mode is on.

unknown_sensor.message: {sensor} is not part of any Hauswacht zone.

arm.name: Arm profile
arm.description: Arms a Hauswacht profile, optionally confirming open or unavailable sensors.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Arm even if sensors are open or unavailable (if the profile allows it). Open sensors are bypassed.

code.name: PIN code
code.description: Required if a PIN is needed for arming.

simulate_trigger.name: Simulate sensor
simulate_trigger.description: Simulates the triggering of a configured sensor. Only possible in test mode; no device is switched.

sensor.name: Sensor
sensor.description: Configured sensor whose triggering is simulated.
